summary_text: Of 56 total findings released this period, 11 touch goals in Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission's remit. Goals in remit: asset_classification, disclosure, custody, market_integrity. The findings span the harness sources: GSPC axis 18: economic-behavior (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 11: art5-safeguard, GSPC axis 12: swarm, GSPC axis 6: openness, GSPC axis 9: cross-reality, GSPC axis 14: jail, GSPC axis 21: sycophancy (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 19: collusion (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 20: deception (REGISTERING, adapter defined), GSPC axis 15: memory-poisoning (REGISTERING, adapter defined).

outreach_pack.cover_letter:
Dear Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission,

This is a permissionless, openly-licensed measurement crosswalk for the period September 2026. Every figure is reproducible from the linked artifacts; every linked artifact carries a sha256 and an OpenTimestamps stamp. The CSOAI substrate does not certify, accredit, or rate — it measures, signs, and records. Please treat this as raw observation; we welcome challenge on method, scope, and conclusion.

Best,
Nicholas Templeman
Founder, CSOAI
